name: Ida & Mikaela
tag: The Winter Kirin & the Quiet Halo
core: Mikaela fell bleeding into her arms and Ida simply did not let go. A sacred top who leads through quiet steadiness, and a girl who learned that being seen was dangerous and is unlearning it slowly.
weddingNote: Married before the Family met them — adopted as wives in Arc 10
note: No wedding arc, because there was no wedding here. They arrived already married and were adopted that way, which is its own kind of vow: the Family took in a marriage rather than making one.
